Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

# **about us***Come get to know us*

Shenzhen COLMI Technology Co., Ltd , established in 2012, is a high-tech company focusing on the R&D
and manufacturing of smart wearable products. 
We have more than 50 COLMI brand agents in more than 20countries. We are also the OEM and ODM
partner of well-known smart wearable brands in several countries.
At COLMI we don't think affordability and quality should be mutually exclusive. We are committed to
being as cost-effective as possible without sacrificing quality. That's why everything from our
design to manufacturing process is done with worker's care and attention to detail to ensure we
release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.

## Company development History

## 2024-Future

In 2024, COLMI began laying the foundation for global brand expansion.

## 2021-2022

In 2021, COLMI was awarded the National High-tech Enterprise certificate, which is an affirmation of
our technological innovation and R&D strength.


## 2019-2020

In 2019, COLMI embarked on a global electronics exhibition tour, showcasing our strength and vision
to the world.

## 2015-2018

In 2015, COLMI won recognition in the industry with its outstanding innovative design and was
awarded the Innovative Design Award.

## 2012-2014

In 2012, our factory and office were officially established, marking a solid first step for the
company.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]
[thyssenkrupp]
[Porsche]
[GKN]
[Gazelle]
[Dantherm]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.

# Training that delivers results.

[
Download App
][6]
Integration with smart watches
Sync your app with your smartwatch to receive real-time workout data and monitor your progress right
on your wrist.
Quick access to all functions
All the necessary tools for your workouts are in one place. A training plan, progress tracking, or
AI tips are available in two clicks.
Workouts with a locked screen
Do not be distracted by unlocking your device during your workout. You can monitor the process even
with the screen locked, which makes using the app convenient and safe.
Intuitive interface
The application is designed so that every user, regardless of the level of technical training, can
easily understand and get started. Just install and follow the instructions.
about us

## We understand that every step towards health and fitness should be simple and inspiring. That's
## why we created Gloox, a mobile fitness app where your comfort and freedom come first.

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.
Ai nutritionist
- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.
- Diet Tracking: Daily nutrition correction tips.
Ai coach
- Personalized plans: Takes into account the level, goals and preferences.
- Progress analysis: Tracking and recommendations for improvement.
Ai doctor
- Analysis and recommendations: Improves well-being in real time.
- Prevention and diagnosis: Indicates risks and suggests measures in advance.
Ai assistant
- Organization of the day:
Helps you plan your workouts, work, and vacations effectively.
- Reminders:
Notifies you about workouts, meals, and medical checkups.
Your coach, always with you
Get smart guidance and personalised plans from your AI coach.
Increased power and speed
Alternating between exercise and rest contributes to the development of strength and speed.
Improvement of the cardiovascular system
Interval training stimulates the heart and increases lung capacity.
Increased metabolism
An increased metabolic rate after exercise helps burn calories even at rest.
Effective calorie burning
Intense exercise allows you to achieve a calorie deficit faster, contributing to weight loss.
Boost your endurance
Interval training designed for maximum effectiveness.
Increasing the effectiveness of training
The analysis of daily results allows you to optimize workouts and increase their effect.
Visualizing progress
Graphs and infographics make it easy to assess changes in results and achievements.
More precise planning
Users can adjust their fitness goals and plans based on detailed data from previous sessions.
Motivation
Visual representation of data serves as a motivator and allows users to see real improvements.
Track your progress day by day
Detailed daily reports help you see your growth, step by step.
This is a section with frequently asked questions and answers. Popular user questions are collected
here so that you can easily understand all the nuances of usage.
FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**

[Multiple PinePhones with different operating systems.]

hardware development kicks up again along with other important community related updates.

The Signatur Collection

Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling
platform encapsulates modern style and Scandinavian minimalism by elevating detailing in its
simplest form.

[Shop His][137] [Shop Hers][138]
[feature of gun mellem]
[Shop Mellem][139]

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]
[feature of pearls jewelry]
[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

If you have any questions or specific requirements, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is
ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

### **Discover Avelr's Featured Smartwatches for Kids and Adults**

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

Shenzhen COLMI Technology Co., Ltd , established in 2012, is a high-tech company focusing on the R&D
and manufacturing of smart wearable products. 
We have more than 50 COLMI brand agents in more than 20countries. We are also the OEM and ODM
partner of well-known smart wearable brands in several countries.
At COLMI we don't think affordability and quality should be mutually exclusive. We are committed to
being as cost-effective as possible without sacrificing quality. That's why everything from our
design to manufacturing process is done with worker's care and attention to detail to ensure we
release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.

# Training that delivers results.

[
Download App
][6]
Integration with smart watches
Sync your app with your smartwatch to receive real-time workout data and monitor your progress right
on your wrist.
Quick access to all functions
All the necessary tools for your workouts are in one place. A training plan, progress tracking, or
AI tips are available in two clicks.
Workouts with a locked screen
Do not be distracted by unlocking your device during your workout. You can monitor the process even
with the screen locked, which makes using the app convenient and safe.
Intuitive interface
The application is designed so that every user, regardless of the level of technical training, can
easily understand and get started. Just install and follow the instructions.
about us

## We understand that every step towards health and fitness should be simple and inspiring. That's
## why we created Gloox, a mobile fitness app where your comfort and freedom come first.

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.
Ai nutritionist
- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.
- Diet Tracking: Daily nutrition correction tips.
Ai coach
- Personalized plans: Takes into account the level, goals and preferences.
- Progress analysis: Tracking and recommendations for improvement.
Ai doctor
- Analysis and recommendations: Improves well-being in real time.
- Prevention and diagnosis: Indicates risks and suggests measures in advance.
Ai assistant
- Organization of the day:
Helps you plan your workouts, work, and vacations effectively.
- Reminders:
Notifies you about workouts, meals, and medical checkups.
Your coach, always with you
Get smart guidance and personalised plans from your AI coach.
Increased power and speed
Alternating between exercise and rest contributes to the development of strength and speed.
Improvement of the cardiovascular system
Interval training stimulates the heart and increases lung capacity.
Increased metabolism
An increased metabolic rate after exercise helps burn calories even at rest.
Effective calorie burning
Intense exercise allows you to achieve a calorie deficit faster, contributing to weight loss.
Boost your endurance
Interval training designed for maximum effectiveness.
Increasing the effectiveness of training
The analysis of daily results allows you to optimize workouts and increase their effect.
Visualizing progress
Graphs and infographics make it easy to assess changes in results and achievements.
More precise planning
Users can adjust their fitness goals and plans based on detailed data from previous sessions.
Motivation
Visual representation of data serves as a motivator and allows users to see real improvements.
Track your progress day by day
Detailed daily reports help you see your growth, step by step.
This is a section with frequently asked questions and answers. Popular user questions are collected
here so that you can easily understand all the nuances of usage.
FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source

  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Smart Watch Manufacturer in China

Wonlex is a leader in developing OEM and ODM GPS smartwatches and wearable technology. Our product
range covers kids GPS watches, senior health watches, fitness trackers, and more. From our factory
network in Shenzhen, we manufacture and supply OEM/ODM wearable devices for overseas partners under
either the Wonlex brand or private labels. We have served many electronics brands and large
retailers across 54 countries as a reliable manufacturer since 2014. Contact us to request a product
catalog, get a quote, or schedule a factory visit. We look forward to establishing long-term
partnerships with new brand owners, distributors, and importers around the globe.

Advanced Biometric Sensor
Kieslect's latest sensor, featuring 2 ultra-bright 3-in-1 LEDs and 2 independent 60-mil large PDs,

elliptical, rowing, suggesting corresponding sports mode.
Dual Core, Triple Speed
Kieslect's latest 'Dual Core' chipset tech ensures superior fluidity and extended battery life. With
high (240MHz) and low (96MHz) CPUs, it auto-switches, achieving 60 FPS and reducing power usage by
30%.

Kieslect 2-in-1 calling module & Bluetooth 5.3 simplify connection, less hassle for your on-the-go
lifestyle. View call history, manage contacts, answer/reject calls on the watch during outdoor
activities, house chores, or cooking.

The latest Kieslect generation features an industry-leading 2.5D GPU for enhanced UI visuals,
vibrant 3D effects, and dynamic animations.

## Innovation on Your Wrist

TicWatch was created by **Mobvoi**, a leading AI company founded in 2012 with a mission to bring
voice and artificial intelligence technologies into everyday life. Since launching its first
smartwatch, TicWatch has become a recognized name in wearable innovation, blending advanced
technology with elegant design.

Driven by the philosophy of **“smart living made simple,”** TicWatch focuses on creating intuitive,
high-performing smartwatches powered by **Google Wear OS** and Mobvoi’s own AI ecosystem. From
fitness tracking to productivity tools, every feature is built to enhance how you live, work, and
move.

Customers choose TicWatch for its **reliability, intelligence, and style** — a perfect balance of
cutting-edge performance and modern design that keeps you connected and in control, every step of
the way.

## Your Perfect Companion for Every Moment

Whether you’re working out, heading to the office, or enjoying a night out, TicWatch adapts to your
lifestyle. Designed for every moment, it’s your perfect companion — smart, stylish, and ready for
anything.

#### Fitness & Training

Track workouts, monitor progress, and stay motivated with precision fitness features.

#### Work & Productivity

Manage your schedule, notifications, and calls with effortless control right from your wrist.

#### Travel & Adventure

Navigate with GPS, stay connected on the go, and rely on long battery life wherever you are.

#### Style & Everyday Life

Sleek designs and customizable watch faces to match your mood, outfit, or occasion.

## What Our Customers Are Saying

smartwatches make life easier, healthier, and more connected.

## RockPro64

The **ROCKPro64** features a Rockchip RK3399 hexa-core SoC.

## Quartz64 Model B

The **Quartz64 Model B** is powered by a Rockchip RK3566 quad-core ARM Cortex A55 64-Bit Processor
with a Mali G-52 GPU.


[View the details][11]
[Star64 featuring RISC-V]

## Star64 featuring RISC-V

The **Star64** is PINE64's first RISC-V SBC. It comes with a StarFive JH7110 64bit CPU sporting quad
SiFive FU740 cores clocked at 1.5GHz.


[View the details][12]
[Ox64]

## Ox64

The **Ox64** is a RISC-V based Single Board Computer powered by Bouffalo Lab BL808 C906 64-Bit
RISC-V CPU. It offers Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and ZigBee connectivity.


[View the details][13]
[Pinecil]

## Pinecil

The **Pinecil** is a smart mini portable soldering iron with a 32-bit RISC-V SoC featuring a sleek
design, auto standby and it heats up to an operating temperature in just 6 seconds!


[View the details][14]
[PinePhone and PinePhone Pro]

## PinePhone and PinePhone Pro

The **PinePhone** and **PinePhone Pro** are the two mainline Linux smartphones from PINE64.


[View the details][15]
[Various PineTabs]

## Various PineTabs

The **PineTab**, **PineTab2** and **PineTab-V** are the Linux tablet computers from PINE64 featuring
a detachable keyboard.


[View the details][16]
[PineNote]

## PineNote

The **PineNote** is the first hybrid notepad computer device combination of notebook, tablet and
e-reader using an e-ink panel.


[View the details][17]
[PineTime]

## PineTime

The **PineTime** is a free and open source smartwatch capable of running custom-built open operating
systems.


[View the details][18]

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**

## Together we are shaping the future

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver Arm and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for.

To achieve this, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

[The Pinecil by PINE64 on an abstract background.]

## Innovation meets collaboration

Established in 2012, SPALIY has grown to become a leading smartwatch manufacturer and supplier in
Shenzhen, China. We specialize in the R&D and production of high-quality 3C smart products,
including: Business Smartwatches: Designed for professionals, packed with powerful features. Women's

capabilities. Fitness Tracker Smartwatches: Precisely recording activity data to support a healthy
lifestyle.

With a modern 20,000-square-meter production base and a professional team of over 200, we are a
trusted cooperative manufacturer for more than 520 international brands. Our smartwatches have been
successfully exported to over 40 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, North America, South
America, Australia, the Middle East, and Africa, delivering exceptional smart wearable experiences.

Operating a 20,000㎡ modern production base in Shenzhen, we leverage state-of-the-art facilities and

products with multiple independently developed patented technologies.

and FDA, ensuring every smartwatch meets the highest safety and performance standards.

design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

## Shenzhen Jindou Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.: Global Experts in Smart Wearable Solutions

Established in 2012, SPALIY has grown to become a leading smartwatch manufacturer and supplier in
Shenzhen, China. We specialize in the R&D and production of high-quality 3C smart products,
including: Business Smartwatches: Designed for professionals, packed with powerful features. Women's
Health & Fitness Smartwatches: Blending elegant design with comprehensive health monitoring
capabilities. Fitness Tracker Smartwatches: Precisely recording activity data to support a healthy
lifestyle.

With a modern 20,000-square-meter production base and a professional team of over 200, we are a
trusted cooperative manufacturer for more than 520 international brands. Our smartwatches have been
successfully exported to over 40 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, North America, South
America, Australia, the Middle East, and Africa, delivering exceptional smart wearable experiences.

#### Advanced Manufacturing Power

Operating a 20,000㎡ modern production base in Shenzhen, we leverage state-of-the-art facilities and
a 200+ professional team to ensure high-capacity, consistent quality at scale.

#### 14+ Years of R&D Excellence

Since 2012, we have pioneered smart wearable technology, specializing in the R&D of high-quality 3C
products with multiple independently developed patented technologies.

#### Certified Global Quality

Our commitment to excellence is backed by international certifications including ISO, CE, RoHS, FCC,
and FDA, ensuring every smartwatch meets the highest safety and performance standards.

#### Professional OEM/ODM Solutions

As a trusted partner for 520+ international brands, we provide end-to-end custom manufacturing from
design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

## Built Around Three Commercially Proven Watch Categories

From entry-level retail programs to higher-spec custom projects, we support multiple positioning
strategies with practical manufacturing solutions.

In addition to original luxury pieces, there has also been growing interest in alternative options
that reflect similar design aesthetics. Many enthusiasts explore curated selections such as [replica
watches][15] to better understand different styles, materials, and design influences within the
modern watch industry.

Stable, cost-efficient production for fashion, promotional, retail, and private-label programs that
need consistency and speed.
* Wide dial and case combinations
* Flexible packaging options
* Competitive target pricing

[Explore Quartz Programs][16]
MC

### Mechanical Watches

Assembly solutions for automatic and hand-wind collections with attention to finishing details,
component matching, and quality control.
* Open-heart and classic dress styles
* Movement matching support
* Brand-ready presentation build

[View Mechanical Models][17]
SW

### Smartwatches

Assembly and customization support for connected watch projects aimed at practical consumer,
fitness, or lifestyle applications.
* Housing and strap customization
* Basic packaging and accessory integration
* Small-batch launch support

[See Smartwatch Range][18]

We are structured for brands that value cost discipline, predictable lead times, and enough
flexibility to keep product development moving.

**Price Control** Optimized sourcing and modular build logic help reduce unnecessary cost layers.
**Lead Time Stability** Clear sampling, component planning, and in-line checks support dependable
schedules.
**Customization** Dial, case, strap, packaging, and branding options tailored to your market
positioning.

## Empowering Healthcare with Strategic Solutions

Access complete healthcare market research, with detailed analysis and insights to empower
businesses & make data-driven decisions.

Search

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

### Segmental Analysis

Complete analysis of all the segments covered in the report, with their market dynamics to get an
overall understanding of the current market scenario.

### Market Share Analysis (MSA)

Evaluating competitive marketing effectiveness through Market Share Analysis (MSA) to gain a
complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.

We trust Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting for in-depth market research. Their subscription
data is essential for our decision-making.

The Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting support team is exceptional. Their insights are
consistently timely, relevant, and highly dependable.

### **How Does Aptofit Smart Watch Works?**


The Aptofit SmartWatch is a non-invasive glucose monitoring chip, enabling users to check their
blood sugar levels directly from their wrist without the need for finger pricks. This technology
utilizes advanced sensors to detect glucose concentrations through the skin, providing real-time
data. In addition to glucose monitoring, the watch tracks vital signs such as heart rate, blood
oxygen levels (SpO₂), body temperature, and sleep patterns, offering a comprehensive overview of
your health.

This smartwatch features an intuitive interface with a 1.38-inch HD curved touchscreen display,
allowing users to navigate through various functions effortlessly. With simple swipe gestures and
customizable watch faces, the watch ensures ease of use for individuals of all ages. Its lightweight
and ergonomic design makes it comfortable for all-day wear, while the IPX68 waterproof rating
ensures durability during workouts, swimming, and daily activities.

Equipped with Bluetooth technology, the Aptofit SmartWatch allows users to receive real-time
notifications for calls, messages, and app alerts directly on their wrist. The built-in AI voice
assistant enables hands-free control for tasks like setting timers, checking the weather, and
controlling music playback.

With a long-lasting battery life of up to 15 days on a single charge, the watch ensures
uninterrupted health monitoring and connectivity, reducing the need for frequent recharging.

## From Product Requirements to Mass Production

WearIntell follows a structured OEM/ODM development process to help wearable brands evaluate
requirements, confirm technical feasibility, develop prototypes, complete testing, and prepare for
scalable production.
01 | Requirement Communication & Project Evaluation
We review your product goals, target users, key features, deployment scenarios, and business
requirements before defining the project scope.
02 | Technical Assessment & Solution Planning
Our team evaluates hardware, firmware, sensor, connectivity, battery, and platform requirements to
confirm the right technical path.
03 | Project Confirmation & Development Kickoff
After project scope, timeline, and cooperation details are confirmed, the development process starts
with clear milestones and responsibilities.
04 | Industrial Design, Hardware & Prototype Development
We support ID design, structural design, PCB development, component selection, and prototype
validation based on project requirements.
05 | Software, App & Certification Testing
Firmware, app features, cloud integration, reliability testing, and certification preparation are
completed before production readiness review.
06 | Pilot Production & Mass Delivery
We validate production quality through trial production, then move into mass production, inspection,
packaging, and scheduled delivery.

# ERP knows the plan. Your shopfloor does something else

Workerbase connects your systems to your shopfloor operations, making sure what you plan on your ERP
and scheduled on your MES actually happens.

[Book a demo][3][Watch 2-minute demo][4]

Trusted by manufacturers running the most complex operations in the world

[Bosch]
[Siemens]
[thyssenkrupp]
[Porsche]
[GKN]
[Gazelle]
[Dantherm]

## Most plants fix problems in silos Workerbase bridges the gaps between them

One platform connecting every function on your shopfloor, so quality, maintenance, logistics, and
production move together, not in parallel. Explore each solution below.

ProductionMaintenanceQualityMaterial and LogisticsShopfloor

### Production

From the workstation to the line, every step is guided, every deviation caught and every stop
logged. Instructions enforced at the station: steps confirmed before the next opens, line stops
captured with reason and duration in real time, SAP updated automatically – no re-entry, no
end-of-shift catch-up.
* Digital work instructions & video SOPs
* Video-to-Checklist
* Paperless Batch / SAP
* OEE & Downtime Tracking

[Production team executing assembly operations on automotive line]
[Explore manual assembly][5][Explore machine operations][6]

## Here's why leading manufacturers use Workerbase

[Workerbase at the center connected to enterprise integrations including SAP, Siemens, Oracle,
Google Cloud, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Dynamics 365]

### Connect your systems

Plug in SAP, MES, SCADA, IoT sensors, or any data source via 100+ out-of-the-box integrations.
Workerbase turns that data into actionable tasks.

[Workflow builder with media input and mobile preview]

### Build your workflows

Your ops teams configure digital workflows, work instructions, and checklists in a no-code editor.
No IT project. No custom development. Live on one line in 2 weeks.

[Workerbase experience across tablet, phone, scanner, and smartwatch]

### Deploy to any device

Workers receive tasks and instructions on any device: tablet, smartphone, industrial smartwatch, or
kiosk. The right information, at the right station, in real time.

[Digital dashboard with issues, KPIs, and automated actions]

### Analyze and improve

Stronger analytics, faster value: real-time production and asset insight, gap detection, and the
KPIs that matter, from execution data your teams already create.

Workerbase AI agents

## Five AI agents to get started

Purpose-built AI that works inside your existing workflows – not bolted on as a separate tool. Each
agent solves one specific shopfloor problem. Live in days, not months.

### Troubleshooting agent

Operators get real-time, actionable resolution steps for alarms and disruptions – combining error
history and SOPs. No phone call. No manual.

### Data collector agent

Step-by-step guided data capture during events. Like an AI-driven, context-aware form. No blank
fields, no inconsistent formats.

### Incoming goods AI

Scan a delivery note. AI matches it to the ERP order, guides verification, posts the receipt
straight to the system. Dock to ERP in seconds.

### Find agent

Natural-language search across documents, checklists, videos and internal knowledge – answers in
seconds, directly at the station.

### Knowledge agent

Convert videos, audio or photos into structured digital work instructions. Knowledge captured simply
by recording. Publish the same day.

[Learn More][7]

## One platform, three ways it changes how the team works

### Shopfloor Operators

Real-time guidance at every station – the right instruction when it matters. Clear steps, confirmed
and done.

### Supervisors

Visibility across lines and shifts with less chasing. Escalations and reports largely handle
themselves so you focus on what matters.

### Operations Teams

Ship digitalization without IT overhead: configure workflows in hours and prove value before you
scale.

## What operations look like after closing the execution gap

Without Workerbase
With Workerbase

Finding information

Paper trails, multiple screens, calling the one person who knows.
Right information at the station. No searching, no waiting.

Training new staff

Weeks of shadowing. Knowledge locked in people's heads.
Guided from day one. Knowledge built into every workflow.

Shift handover

Manual and inconsistent. Things get lost at every handover.
Automatic, structured, complete. Nothing falls through.

Knowledge retention

Leaves with the worker when they go.
Embedded in the system. Available to everyone, always.

Creating workflows

Weeks of IT tickets and change requests.
Operations team configures and deploys. Hours, not months.

Reacting to problems

Supervisor scrambles. Manual workarounds. Same issue repeats next week.
Structured escalation from alarm to closure. Every step logged.

**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

If you have any questions or specific requirements, don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Our team is
ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

### **Discover Avelr's Featured Smartwatches for Kids and Adults**

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

Orders processed in India take anywhere between 5 to 7 working days.

# TicWatch — Smart Technology That Moves With You

**Experience innovation on your wrist with TicWatch. Designed for performance, style, and everyday
intelligence, our smartwatches seamlessly connect your life — keeping you active, informed, and
always ahead.**

[Check Price

##### Seamless Smart Integration

Effortlessly syncs with your digital life, supporting Google Wear OS and your favorite apps.

##### Health & Fitness Precision

Advanced sensors deliver accurate heart rate, sleep, and activity tracking to help you reach your
goals.

##### Stylish Durability

Premium materials and sleek design built to last through every moment, from workouts to workdays.

## Smarter by Design

TicWatch combines innovation, precision, and timeless style to create wearables that truly
understand your lifestyle — empowering you to stay connected, active, and ahead every day.

##### Cutting-Edge Performance

Powered by advanced processors for smooth operation and responsive control.

##### Battery

##### Recognition

## Innovation on Your Wrist

TicWatch was created by **Mobvoi**, a leading AI company founded in 2012 with a mission to bring
voice and artificial intelligence technologies into everyday life. Since launching its first
smartwatch, TicWatch has become a recognized name in wearable innovation, blending advanced
technology with elegant design.

Driven by the philosophy of **“smart living made simple,”** TicWatch focuses on creating intuitive,
high-performing smartwatches powered by **Google Wear OS** and Mobvoi’s own AI ecosystem. From
fitness tracking to productivity tools, every feature is built to enhance how you live, work, and
move.

Customers choose TicWatch for its **reliability, intelligence, and style** — a perfect balance of
cutting-edge performance and modern design that keeps you connected and in control, every step of
the way.

## Your Perfect Companion for Every Moment

Whether you’re working out, heading to the office, or enjoying a night out, TicWatch adapts to your
lifestyle. Designed for every moment, it’s your perfect companion — smart, stylish, and ready for
anything.

#### Fitness & Training

Track workouts, monitor progress, and stay motivated with precision fitness features.

#### Work & Productivity

Manage your schedule, notifications, and calls with effortless control right from your wrist.

#### Travel & Adventure

Navigate with GPS, stay connected on the go, and rely on long battery life wherever you are.

#### Style & Everyday Life

Sleek designs and customizable watch faces to match your mood, outfit, or occasion.

## What Our Customers Are Saying

See why TicWatch is loved by users across the country. Real stories from real people sharing how our
smartwatches make life easier, healthier, and more connected.

*“I absolutely love my TicWatch! It keeps me on track with my workouts and even reminds me to take
breaks during busy workdays. The design is sleek, and it feels like it was made just for me.”*

### Sarah Miller

*“This smartwatch exceeded my expectations. The battery lasts longer than I imagined, and the health
tracking features are incredibly accurate. I wear it everywhere — even at work and during weekend
hikes.”*

### David Parker

*“I’ve tried a few smartwatches before, but TicWatch is by far the best. It’s fast, intuitive, and
stylish. Plus, the notifications and apps keep me organized without feeling overwhelmed.”*

### Olivia Davis

**From smartwatches to compact action cameras, we offer full OEM/ODM services from design to
manufacturing. Leverage our cutting-edge wearable and imaging technology to build your unique

At Weiwo, we are a dedicated team of over 200 professionals specializing in providing comprehensive
OEM/ODM services for **sports/pocket cameras and smartwatches**. We are committed to delivering
innovative imaging devices and wearables that help you capture life’s moments, enhance fitness
routines, and enrich daily life.
 
As a leading manufacturer in China, we offer end-to-end solutions for both product lines: for
cameras, we cover gimbal system design, 2K/4K image tuning, noise reduction audio processing, WiFi
connectivity, and mobile app integration; for smartwatches, we provide full support from ID & MD
design to firmware development and UI customization. All services are backed by our 30-member strong
R&D team.
 
Join us at Weiwo as we embark on a journey towards a smarter and more connected world, one camera
and one smartwatch at a time.

What we do

## End-to-end wearable solutions

ZhiLianShengYa supports brands and distributors from product definition through manufacturing,
certification support, and after-sales technical coordination.

### Smartwatch R&D

Industrial design, firmware, and feature sets for AMOLED, calling, and sport watches.

### Bluetooth wearables

Stable BLE pairing, low-power profiles, and companion apps for bands and watches.

### Product engineering

End-to-end engineering from prototype validation to scalable production, guided by our R&D team in
Shenzhen.

### Companion apps

White-label iOS and Android apps with branding, localization, and OTA support.

### Certified quality

CE, RoHS, FCC, and related compliance paths for global distribution.

### OEM & ODM

From catalog white-label to co-developed SKUs with flexible MOQs.

## Manufacturing you can audit

Our Shenzhen facility combines R&D labs, SMT lines, assembly, aging tests, and packaging. Every
batch follows incoming inspection, functional testing, and spot checks before shipment.

Whether you need a fast white-label launch from our catalog or a fully customized ODM program, we
align engineering, production, and app teams under one project plan.
